narrator.role: Datin Sarah, BeliLah CEO. Calling from the airport, calm under pressure, no time to waste

segments.text: 10 PM, 10 November. You're on call at BeliLah, Kuala Lumpur.
At midnight, the 11.11 sale opens to three million shoppers.
Datin Sarah, the CEO, calls: "Checkout is down. Why are we down? Were we breached? What is it costing us?"
Three AWS Frontier Agents can answer her. Beat midnight.
"Thank you. That's the honest answer, and it's the one I can take to the board."
Midnight. 11.11 is live. You escaped the war room.
Midnight, and still no answers. The sale opened on a broken checkout.
Try again. The agents will be waiting.
